# 1. Setup and data cleaning
```{r load-data}
data_path <- 'data'
data_files <- list.files(
  path = data_path,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

df_raw_all <- map_dfr(data_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(
    file,
    col_types = cols(
      rt = col_double(),
      response = col_character(),
      correct_response = col_character(),
      correct = col_logical(),
      block_failed = col_logical(),
      blocks_failed_total = col_double(),
      .default = col_guess()
    ),
    na = c("", "NA", "null", "NaN")
  )
  
df %>%
    mutate(
      subj_id = str_match(
        basename(file),
        "Han_curvRep1D_(\\d+)_"
      )[, 2]
    )
}) %>%
  select(
    subj_id, total_experiment_time, age, sex, art_experience, strategy_open,
    rt, stimulus, response, block, block_index, 
    trial_in_block, global_trial_index, trial_kind,
    pattern, feature_ids, features_triplet,
    stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right,
    is_practice, is_catch,
    correct_response, correct, 
    chosen_index, chosen_stimulus, chosen_nv, chosen_ang, chosen_s, chosen_rot, chosen_curv
  )


```

## 1.4 Quality control and exclusions
```{r quality-control}
# each participant must get 75% catch trial accuracy min in each block to pass that block
block_catch_summary <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(trial_kind == "catch") %>%
  group_by(subj_id, block_index) %>%
  summarise(
    n_catch = n(),
    n_correct = sum(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    catch_accuracy = n_correct / n_catch,
    block_use = as.integer(catch_accuracy >= 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count failed blocks per participant and assign subUse flag
subject_quality <- block_catch_summary %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_failed_blocks = sum(block_use == 0), # Count blocks where blockUse = 0
    sub_use = as.integer(n_failed_blocks <= 3), # Flag: 0 if >3 failed, else 1
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View results
subject_quality %>%
  count(sub_use)

# Add subUse flag to original data frame
df_raw_all <- df_raw_all %>%
  left_join(
    subject_quality %>% select(subj_id, sub_use),
    by = "subj_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    block_catch_summary %>%
      select(subj_id, block_index, block_use),
    by = c("subj_id", "block_index")
  )

```


```{r exclusion-summary}
# Calculate total percentage of trials excluded
exclusion_summary <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(
    sub_use == 1,
    trial_kind %in% c("exp_111", "exp_221")
  ) %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_trials = n(),
    excluded_trials = sum(block_use == 0 | rt < 500, na.rm = TRUE),
    included_trials = sum(block_use == 1 & rt >= 500, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate overall exclusion percentage
overall_exclusion <- exclusion_summary %>%
  summarise(
    total_trials_all = sum(total_trials),
    total_excluded = sum(excluded_trials),
    total_included = sum(included_trials),
    exclusion_pct = (total_excluded / total_trials_all) * 100
  )

overall_exclusion

# Leave only the trials for analysis
df_trials <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(
    sub_use == 1,
    block_use == 1,
    rt >= 500,
    trial_kind %in% c("exp_111", "exp_221")
  )
```

## 1.5 Item-level data for triads
```{r construct-item-data}
# each row = one item in the triad. 
df_items <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subj_id,
    triad_id,
    chosen_index,
    stim_left,
    stim_middle,
    stim_right
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "stim_path"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_index = case_when(
      position == "stim_left" ~ 0L,
      position == "stim_middle" ~ 1L,
      position == "stim_right" ~ 2L
    ),
    is_chosen = pos_index == chosen_index,
    sm_s = as.numeric(str_match(stim_path, "s([0-9.]+)_rot")[, 2]),
    sm = case_when(
      sm_s == 0.0 ~ 0L,
      sm_s == 0.8 ~ 1L,
      sm_s == 1.4 ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    nv = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "stim_nv(\\d+)_")[, 2]),
    ang = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "ang(\\d+)_s")[, 2])
  )
```

# 2. Individual behavioral Representational Dissimilarity Matrix (RDM)
```{r stimulus-lookup}
# OVERVIEW: Constructs subject-wise and averaged behavioral RDMs from triad choice data.
# - Data: Subjects choose 1 of 3 stimuli per triad (27 unique stimuli).
# - Dissimilarity D for pair (i,j): P(pair split as chosen-non_chosen | co-occur in triad).
# - High D = often discriminated = behaviorally dissimilar.
stim_lookup <- df_items %>%
  distinct(sm, nv, ang) %>%
  arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>%
  mutate(stim_id = row_number())

stopifnot(nrow(stim_lookup) == 27)
```

```{r pair-data}
# Step 1: Prep data and extract chosen-non_chosen pairs
triad_long <- df_items %>%
  select(
    subj_id,
    triad_id,
    pos_index,
    is_chosen,
    sm,
    nv,
    ang
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stim_lookup,
    by = c("sm", "nv", "ang")
  )

pairs_id <- triad_long %>%
  inner_join(
    triad_long,
    by = c("subj_id", "triad_id"),
    suffix = c("_i", "_j")
  ) %>%
  filter(pos_index_i < pos_index_j) %>%
  mutate(
    low = pmin(stim_id_i, stim_id_j),
    high = pmax(stim_id_i, stim_id_j),
    chosen_nonchosen =
      (is_chosen_i & !is_chosen_j) |
      (!is_chosen_i & is_chosen_j)
  )
# Output: One row per subj-triple-chosen_non pair (2 per triplet).

```

```{r individual-rdms}
# Step 2: Compute per-subject D
D_subj <- pairs_id %>%
  group_by(subj_id, low, high) %>%
  summarise(
    n_appear = n(),
    n_chosen_nonchosen = sum(chosen_nonchosen),
    D = n_chosen_nonchosen / n_appear,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

make_rdm <- function(data, n_stimuli = 27) {
  rdm <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = n_stimuli,
    ncol = n_stimuli
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    low <- data$low[i]
    high <- data$high[i]
    rdm[low, high] <- data$D[i]
    rdm[high, low] <- data$D[i]
  }

  diag(rdm) <- 0
  rdm
}

participant_rdms <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(RDM = map(data, make_rdm)) %>%
  select(subj_id, RDM)
```

## 2.1 Ideal RDMs
```{r ideal-rdms}
# First, build an empirical RDM to define the NA pattern
D_avg <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(low, high) %>%
  summarise(
    D_mean = mean(D, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_stim <- nrow(stim_lookup)
D_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_stim, ncol = n_stim)
rownames(D_mat) <- colnames(D_mat) <- stim_lookup$stim_id

for (k in seq_len(nrow(D_avg))) {
  i <- D_avg$low[k]
  j <- D_avg$high[k]
  D_mat[i, j] <- D_avg$D_mean[k]
  D_mat[j, i] <- D_avg$D_mean[k]
}

diag(D_mat) <- 0

# Now define ideal RDMs
neq_mat <- function(x) outer(x, x, "!=") * 1

ideal_sm <- neq_mat(stim_lookup$sm)
ideal_nv <- neq_mat(stim_lookup$nv)
ideal_ang <- neq_mat(stim_lookup$ang)

ideal_add <- ideal_sm + ideal_nv + ideal_ang
ideal_add01 <- ideal_add / 3

ideal_sm[is.na(D_mat)] <- NA
ideal_nv[is.na(D_mat)] <- NA
ideal_ang[is.na(D_mat)] <- NA
ideal_add01[is.na(D_mat)] <- NA

ensure_dimnames <- function(M) {
  colnames(M) <- seq_len(ncol(M))
  rownames(M) <- seq_len(nrow(M))
  M
}

D_mat <- ensure_dimnames(D_mat)
ideal_sm <- ensure_dimnames(ideal_sm)
ideal_nv <- ensure_dimnames(ideal_nv)
ideal_ang <- ensure_dimnames(ideal_ang)
ideal_add01 <- ensure_dimnames(ideal_add01)
```

# 2.2 Visualize ideal RDMs 
```{r ideal-visualize}
matrix_to_long <- function(M) {
  as_tibble(M, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
    mutate(id_i = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-id_i, names_to = "id_j", values_to = "val") %>%
    mutate(
      id_i = as.integer(id_i),
      id_j = as.integer(id_j)
    )
}

plot_matrix <- function(
  M, stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Dissimilarity",
  title = "",
  limits = c(0, 1),
  palette = "plasma",
  na_value = "grey90",
  legend_title_size = 9,
  show_sm_labels = TRUE,
  show_nv_labels = TRUE,
  show_ang_right = TRUE,
  base_size = 14
) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(M))
  stopifnot(all(c("sm", "nv", "ang", "stim_id") %in% names(stim_lookup)))
  
  stim_order <- stim_lookup %>% arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>% pull(stim_id)
  N <- length(stim_order)

  M_long <- matrix_to_long(M) %>%
    mutate(
      id_i = factor(id_i, levels = stim_order),
      id_j = factor(id_j, levels = stim_order)
    )

  ang_right <- stim_lookup %>%
    arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>%
    transmute(y = stim_id, label = paste0("a", ang))

  sm_blocks <- tibble(
    sm = 0:2,
    start = c(1, 10, 19),
    end = c(9, 18, 27),
    mid = c(5, 14, 23),
    label = paste0("sm", 0:2)
  )

  nv_blocks <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    sm = 0:2,
    nv = 1:3
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      start = sm * 9 + (nv - 1) * 3 + 1,
      end = start + 2,
      mid = (start + end) / 2,
      nv = paste0("n", nv)
    )

  p <- ggplot(M_long, aes(id_i, id_j, fill = val)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = palette,
      direction = -1,
      limits = limits,
      name = value_name,
      na.value = na_value
    ) +
    coord_equal(clip = "off", xlim = c(.5, N + .5), ylim = c(.5, N + .5)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 130, 70, 90)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title)
  
  
  sm_cuts <- seq(9.5, 18.5, by = 9)
  nv_cuts <- sort(c(sm_cuts - 6, sm_cuts - 3, sm_cuts + 3, sm_cuts + 6))
  ang_cuts <- setdiff(seq(1.5, 26.5, by = 1), c(sm_cuts, nv_cuts))

  add_lines <- function(p, xs, lw, a = 1)
    Reduce(`+`, lapply(xs, \(x)
      list(
        geom_vline(xintercept = x, linewidth = lw, alpha = a),
        geom_hline(yintercept = x, linewidth = lw, alpha = a)
      )
    ), init = p)
  
  p <- p |>
    add_lines(sm_cuts, 0.9) |>
    add_lines(nv_cuts, 0.45, 0.9) |>
    add_lines(ang_cuts, 0.22, 0.55)

  if (show_ang_right)
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = ang_right,
      aes(x = N + 1.2, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0, size = 3
    )

  if (show_sm_labels)
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = sm_blocks,
      aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.6,
      size = 3
    )
  
  if (show_nv_labels)
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = nv_blocks,
      aes(x = 0, y = mid, label = nv),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.4,
      size = 3
    )

  p
}

p_sm <- plot_matrix(
  ideal_sm,
  stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Dissimilarity",
  title = "Ideal D (smoothness)"
)

p_nv <- plot_matrix(
  ideal_nv,
  stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Dissimilarity",
  title = "Ideal D (vertices)"
)

p_ang <- plot_matrix(
  ideal_ang,
  stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Dissimilarity",
  title = "Ideal D (angle)"
)

p_add <- plot_matrix(
  ideal_add01,
  stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Dissimilarity",
  title = "Ideal D (additive)"
)

p_sm
p_nv
p_ang
p_add
```

# 3. K-means Clustering, cluster RDMs, and regression
# 3.1 Participant RDMs
```{r participant-RDMs}
n_items <- 27

participant_rdms <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    RDM = list({
      D_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_items, ncol = n_items)
      rownames(D_mat) <- colnames(D_mat) <- as.character(1:n_items)

      for (k in seq_len(n())) {
        i <- low[k]
        j <- high[k]
        D_mat[i, j] <- D[k]
        D_mat[j, i] <- D[k]
      }

      diag(D_mat) <- 0
      D_mat
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

get_upper_vec <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]

participant_rdms_vec <- participant_rdms %>%
  mutate(RDM_vec = map(RDM, get_upper_vec))

subj_ids <- participant_rdms$subj_id
n_subj <- length(subj_ids)

```

# 3.2 Select and fit the cluster solution
```{r}
#  Prepare data & distances
complete_pairs <- do.call(rbind, participant_rdms_vec$RDM_vec)
complete_pairs <- complete_pairs[, apply(complete_pairs, 2, function(x) all(!is.na(x)))]

pp_coords <- complete_pairs
pp_dist <- dist(pp_coords)

cat("Data:", nrow(pp_coords), "subjects x", ncol(pp_coords), "pairs\n")

# ELBOW plot
max_k <- 8
wss <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  km <- kmeans(pp_coords, centers = k, nstart = 50)
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(
  1:max_k, wss,
  type = "b", pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Total within-cluster SS",
  main = "Elbow Method for Optimal k"
)

# SILHOUETTE plot
sil_width <- rep(NA_real_, max_k)

for (k in 2:max_k) {
  km <- kmeans(pp_coords, centers = k, nstart = 50)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, pp_dist)
  sil_width[k] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}

plot(
  2:max_k, sil_width[2:max_k],
  type = "b", pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Mean silhouette width",
  main = "Silhouette Method for Optimal k"
)

abline(v = which.max(sil_width), lty = 2, col = "red")

# Choose best k & fit final clustering
k_opt <- 2
km_final <- kmeans(pp_coords, centers = k_opt, nstart = 100)

cluster_sizes <- table(km_final$cluster)
cluster_order <- as.numeric(names(sort(cluster_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)))
new_labels <- match(km_final$cluster, cluster_order)

participant_clusters <- tibble(
  subj_id = subj_ids,
  cluster = factor(new_labels)
)

print(table(participant_clusters$cluster))

```

# 3.3 Cluster-level RDMs
```{r}
cluster_rdms <- participant_rdms %>%
  left_join(participant_clusters, by = "subj_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subj = n(),
    mean_RDM = list(
      Reduce(`+`, RDM) / n()
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot cluster mean RDMs (same style as ideal RDM plots)

cluster_plots_RDM <- cluster_rdms %>%
  mutate(
    plot = purrr::map2(
      mean_RDM,
      cluster,
      ~ plot_matrix(
        M = .x,
        stim_lookup = stim_lookup,
        value_name = "Dissimilarity",
        limits = c(0, max(unlist(cluster_rdms$mean_RDM), na.rm = TRUE)),
        palette = "plasma",
        title = paste0("Cluster ", .y, " (n = ", cluster_rdms$n_subj[as.integer(.y)], ")")
      )
    )
  )

# View cluster RDM plots
cluster_plots_RDM$plot[[1]]  # Cluster 1
cluster_plots_RDM$plot[[2]]  # Cluster 2 (if k_opt = 2)

```

# 3.4 Regression of cluster RDMs onto ideal RDMs
```{r}
# Helper: extract upper triangle of a symmetric RDM as a vector
get_rdm_vec <- function(M) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(M))
  M[upper.tri(M, diag = FALSE)]
}

# Vectorize ideal RDMs once
v_sm   <- get_rdm_vec(ideal_sm)
v_nv   <- get_rdm_vec(ideal_nv)
v_ang  <- get_rdm_vec(ideal_ang)
v_add  <- get_rdm_vec(ideal_add01)

# Build a predictor matrix (complete cases across all ideal models)
model_mat <- cbind(sm = v_sm, nv = v_nv, ang = v_ang, additive = v_add)


cluster_weights <- cluster_rdms %>%
  mutate(
    # Vectorize each cluster's mean RDM (dependent variable)
    emp_vec = map(mean_RDM, get_rdm_vec),

    # Fit multiple regression: empirical dissimilarities ~ sm + nv + ang
    fit = map(emp_vec, ~ {
      ok <- complete.cases(.x, model_mat)
      y <- .x[ok]
      X <- model_mat[ok, , drop = FALSE]
      lm(y ~ sm + nv + ang, data = as.data.frame(X))
    }),

    # Extract coefficients
    coef_raw = map(fit, ~ {
      s <- summary(.x)
      tibble(
        feature = rownames(s$coefficients)[-1],  # drop intercept
        beta_raw = s$coefficients[-1, "Estimate"]
      )
    }),

    # Normalize to sum to 1
    coef_tbl = map(fit, ~ {
  s <- summary(.x)
  tibble(
    feature = rownames(s$coefficients)[-1],
    beta_raw = s$coefficients[-1, "Estimate"],
    se_raw   = s$coefficients[-1, "Std. Error"]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      beta = beta_raw / sum(beta_raw),
      se   = se_raw / sum(beta_raw)
    ) %>%
    select(feature, beta, se)
    })
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, coef_tbl) %>%
  unnest(coef_tbl)
cluster_weights

# Plot regression coefficients per cluster
feat_levels <- c("sm", "nv", "ang")
feat_cols   <- scales::hue_pal()(3)  # default ggplot2 colours: red, green, blue
names(feat_cols) <- feat_levels

feat_levels <- c("sm", "nv", "ang")
feat_cols   <- scales::hue_pal()(3)
names(feat_cols) <- feat_levels

cluster_weights %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(feature, levels = feat_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = beta, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = beta - se, ymax = beta + se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = feat_cols,
    name = "Feature"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Feature Weights from RDM Regression",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Normalized weight",
    fill = "Feature"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 0.65))
```

# 3.5 Mixed-effects RSA per cluster (on individual RDMs)
```{r}
# Build predictor table from stim IDs, for each pair
pair_features <- expand_grid(
  low = 1:27,
  high = 1:27
) %>%
  filter(low < high) %>%
  left_join(
    stim_lookup %>%
      rename(
        low = stim_id,
        sm_low = sm,
        nv_low = nv,
        ang_low = ang
      ),
    by = "low"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stim_lookup %>%
      rename(
        high = stim_id,
        sm_high = sm,
        nv_high = nv,
        ang_high = ang
      ),
    by = "high"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sm  = as.numeric(sm_low != sm_high),
    nv  = as.numeric(nv_low != nv_high),
    ang = as.numeric(ang_low != ang_high)
  ) %>%
  select(low, high, sm, nv, ang)

# Add cluster labels to subject-level RDM data
rsa_lmm_df <- D_subj %>%
  left_join(participant_clusters, by = "subj_id") %>%
  left_join(pair_features, by = c("low", "high")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# Fit one mixed model per cluster, with random intercept for subject
cluster_lmm_results <- rsa_lmm_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ lmer(
      D ~ sm + nv + ang + (1 | subj_id),
      data = .x,
      REML = FALSE
    )),
    coef_tbl = map(fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, fit, coef_tbl) %>%
  unnest(coef_tbl) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    feature = recode(term,
                     sm = "sm",
                     nv = "nv",
                     ang = "ang"),
    se = std.error,
    beta = estimate
  )

# Bar plot (same colours and order as main RSA plot)
feat_levels <- c("sm", "nv", "ang")
feat_cols   <- scales::hue_pal()(3)
names(feat_cols) <- feat_levels

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

cluster_lmm_results %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(feature, levels = feat_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = beta, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = beta - se, ymax = beta + se),
    position = pd,
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = feat_cols,
    name = "Feature"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster-level Feature Weights from Mixed-Effects RSA",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fixed-effect coefficient",
    fill = "Feature"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 0.65))

```

# 4. Multidimensional scaling on clusters
```{r}
run_ordinal_mds <- function(rdm, ndim) {
  weight_matrix <- ifelse(is.na(rdm), 0, 1)
  dissimilarity_matrix <- rdm
  dissimilarity_matrix[is.na(dissimilarity_matrix)] <- 0

  diag(dissimilarity_matrix) <- 0
  diag(weight_matrix) <- 0

  smacof::mds(
    delta = dissimilarity_matrix,
    weightmat = weight_matrix,
    type = "ordinal",
    ndim = ndim
  )
}

extract_mds_coords <- function(mds_fit, stim_lookup) {
  as.data.frame(mds_fit$conf) %>%
    rownames_to_column("stim_id") %>%
    mutate(stim_id = as.integer(stim_id)) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0("D", seq_along(.)),
      -stim_id
    ) %>%
    left_join(stim_lookup, by = "stim_id")
}

```

# 4.1 Dimensionality selection per cluster
```{r}
## Compute stress for multiple dimensionalities
# stress is a lack-of-fit measure between:
# The observed dissimilarities and the distances in the low-dimensional space (e.g., 2D)
# “How much information about the dissimilarity structure is lost when I force it into 2 dimensions?”
# If stress is low, then the 2D configuration preserves the rank order of your empirical dissimilarities well.
# If stress is high, 2D is insufficient → try 3D, 4D, etc.
# Stress < 0.05 → excellent fit
# 0.05–0.10 → good
# 0.10–0.20 → fair
# 0.20 → poor
dims <- 1:8

cluster_stress <- cluster_rdms %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, mean_RDM) %>%
  mutate(
    stress = map(
      mean_RDM,
      ~ map_dfr(dims, function(ndim) {
        fit <- run_ordinal_mds(.x, ndim)

        tibble(
          ndim = ndim,
          stress = fit$stress
        )
      })
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(stress)

cluster_stress

ggplot(
  cluster_stress,
  aes(x = ndim, y = stress)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of dimensions",
    y = "Stress",
    title = "Ordinal MDS stress by cluster"
  )

```

```{r}
ndim_by_cluster <- c(
  `1` = 3,
  `2` = 5
)

cluster_mds <- cluster_rdms %>%
  mutate(
    ndim = ndim_by_cluster[as.character(cluster)],
    mds = map2(

    ),
    stress = map_dbl(mds, "stress"),
    coordinates = map2(
      mds,
      mean_RDM,
      ~ extract_mds_coords(.x, stim_lookup)
    )
  )

cluster_mds %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, ndim, stress)

cluster_coords <- cluster_mds %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, coordinates) %>%
  unnest(coordinates)
```

# 4.3 2D projection plots of cluster specific MDS (with stimulus images)
```{r}
cluster_coords_img <- cluster_coords %>%
  mutate(
    s_val = case_when(
      sm == 0 ~ 0.0,
      sm == 1 ~ 0.8,
      sm == 2 ~ 1.4,
      TRUE    ~ NA_real_
    ),
    nv_str   = paste0("nv", nv),
    ang_str  = paste0("ang", ang),
    s_str    = paste0("s", format(s_val, nsmall = 1)),
    img_file = paste0("stim_", nv_str, "_", ang_str, "_", s_str, "_rot+000.png"),
    img_path = file.path("../figures/stimuli", img_file)
  )

plot_mds_projection_img <- function(df, d1, d2, title = "") {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[d1]], y = .data[[d2]])) +
    geom_image(aes(image = img_path), size = 0.1) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(x = d1, y = d2, title = title)
}

# Get cluster-specific max dimension
cluster_max_dim <- tibble(
  cluster = factor(names(ndim_by_cluster)),
  max_dim = as.integer(ndim_by_cluster)
)

# Generate all unique pairs of dimensions per cluster
dim_pairs_list <- split(
  cluster_max_dim,
  seq_len(nrow(cluster_max_dim))
) %>%
  map(function(row) {
    cl <- row$cluster
    nd <- row$max_dim
    dims <- paste0("D", seq_len(nd))
    pairs <- t(combn(dims, 2))
    tibble(
      cluster = cl,
      d1 = pairs[, 1],
      d2 = pairs[, 2]
    )
  })

dim_pairs <- bind_rows(dim_pairs_list)

# Loop over clusters and dimension pairs
for (cl in unique(dim_pairs$cluster)) {
  dfc <- cluster_coords_img %>% filter(cluster == cl)
  pairs_cl <- dim_pairs %>% filter(cluster == cl)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs_cl))) {
    d1 <- pairs_cl$d1[i]
    d2 <- pairs_cl$d2[i]

    title <- paste0(
      "Cluster ", cl,
      " — Ordinal MDS ", ndim_by_cluster[as.character(cl)], "D: ",
      d1, " vs ", d2
    )

    print(
      plot_mds_projection_img(dfc, d1, d2, title)
    )
  }
}
```

# 5. Vector fitting for clusters
```{r}
# Vector fitting / projection: Project each feature as a vector through the space that maximally correlates with point positions.
# D1, D2, D3: coordinates of the fitted feature vector

#r2: strength of feature representation (proportion of variance in the feature explained by projection onto the entire MDS configuration)

# pr(>r): The probability that a random permutation of the feature values would produce an r² as large or larger than the observed one 

run_vector_fit <- function(data, ndim = 4, permutations = 999) {
  coordinate_columns <- paste0("D", seq_len(ndim))

  coordinates <- data %>%
    select(all_of(coordinate_columns))

  features <- data %>%
    select(sm, nv, ang) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

  vegan::envfit(
    coordinates,
    features,
    permutations = permutations,
    choices = seq_len(ndim)
  )
}

cluster_vector_fits <- cluster_coords %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    ndim = map_int(
      cluster,
      ~ ndim_by_cluster[[as.character(.x)]]
    ),
    envfit = map2(
      data,
      ndim,
      run_vector_fit
    )
  )

vector_fit_results <- cluster_vector_fits %>%
  transmute(
    cluster,
    results = map(
      envfit,
      ~ tibble(
        feature = names(.x$vectors$r),
        r_squared = unname(.x$vectors$r),
        p_value = unname(.x$vectors$pvals)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(results) %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(
      feature,
      levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang"),
      labels = c("sm", "nv", "ang")
    )
  )

vector_fit_results


# Cluster 1
ggplot(
  filter(vector_fit_results, cluster == 1),
  aes(
    x = feature,
    y = r_squared,
    fill = feature
  )
) +

  ) +

    ),

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +

    x = NULL,

    title = "Cluster 1"
  )

# Cluster 2
```

# 5.1 Vector loadings per dimension and cluster
```{r}
extract_abs_loadings <- function(envfit_obj, cluster_id) {
  arrows <- envfit_obj$vectors$arrows %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature")      # sm, nv, ang

  dim_names <- colnames(envfit_obj$vectors$arrows)  # e.g. D1, D2, D3 or D1..D5

  arrows %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = cluster_id,
      feature = factor(feature, levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang"))
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(dim_names),
      names_to = "dimension",
      values_to = "loading"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      loading = abs(loading)          # ignore sign
    )
}

# Extract loadings per cluster using the actual ndim per cluster
load_all <- map2_dfr(
  cluster_vector_fits$envfit,
  cluster_vector_fits$cluster,
```

# Export MDS coordinates + stimulus info for 3D website
```{r}
# =========================
# Export MDS coordinates + stimulus info for 3D website
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# --------------------------------------------------
# USER SETTINGS: edit these in each analysis file
# --------------------------------------------------
experiment_id <- "Exp1"         # "Exp1" or "Exp2"
condition_id  <- "noInstr"    # "curvature" or "noInstr"

# Assumes cluster_coords_3d already exists
# and includes:
#   Exp1: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, ang, sm
#   Exp2: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, rng, sm

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic checks
# --------------------------------------------------
required_common <- c("cluster", "D1", "D2", "D3", "nv", "sm")
missing_common <- setdiff(required_common, names(cluster_coords_3d))

if (length(missing_common) > 0) {
  stop("cluster_coords_3d is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_common, collapse = ", "))
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Build JSON data depending on experiment
# --------------------------------------------------
if (experiment_id == "Exp1") {

  required_exp1 <- c("ang")
  missing_exp1 <- setdiff(required_exp1, names(cluster_coords_3d))

  if (length(missing_exp1) > 0) {
    stop("For Exp1, cluster_coords_3d must contain: ",
         paste(missing_exp1, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Map analysis smoothness coding to image filename coding
  # analysis: sm = 0,1,2
  # image files: s0.0, s0.8, s1.4
  sm_to_file <- c("0" = "0.0",
                  "1" = "0.8",
                  "2" = "1.4")

  mds_web_data <- cluster_coords_3d %>%
    mutate(
      experiment  = experiment_id,
      condition   = condition_id,
      stimulus_id = paste0("nv", nv, "_ang", ang, "_sm", sm),

      s_file = unname(sm_to_file[as.character(sm)]),

      img_file = paste0(
        "stim_nv", nv,
        "_ang", ang,
        "_s", s_file,
        "_rot+000.png"
      ),

      # relative to HTML file location inside this condition folder
      img_path = file.path("..", "figures", "stimuli", img_file),

      rng = NA
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      stimulus_id,
      D1, D2, D3,
      nv, ang, sm, rng,
      img_file,
      img_path
    )

} else if (experiment_id == "Exp2") {

  required_exp2 <- c("rng")
  missing_exp2 <- setdiff(required_exp2, names(cluster_coords_3d))

  if (length(missing_exp2) > 0) {
    stop("For Exp2, cluster_coords_3d must contain: ",
         paste(missing_exp2, collapse = ", "))
  }

  mds_web_data <- cluster_coords_3d %>%
    mutate(
      experiment  = experiment_id,
      condition   = condition_id,
      stimulus_id = paste0("nv", nv, "_rng", rng, "_sm", sm),

      # image names use curv0/1/2 even though analysis uses sm
      img_file = paste0(
        "circle_rng", rng,
        "_N", nv,
        "_curv", sm,
        "_seed10.png"
      ),

      # relative to HTML file location inside this condition folder
      img_path = file.path("..", "figures2", "images", img_file),

      ang = NA
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      stimulus_id,
      D1, D2, D3,
      nv, ang, rng, sm,
      img_file,
      img_path
    )

} else {
  stop("experiment_id must be either 'Exp1' or 'Exp2'")
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Make output folder
# --------------------------------------------------
dir.create("mds_site", showWarnings = FALSE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write JSON
# --------------------------------------------------
write_json(
  mds_web_data,
  path = file.path("mds_site", "mds_data.json"),
  pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)

cat("Saved JSON to:", file.path("mds_site", "mds_data.json"), "\n")
```
# Export 3D envfit vectors for website
```{r}
# =========================
# Export 3D envfit vectors for website
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tibble)
library(vegan)

# --------------------------------------------------
# USER SETTINGS: edit these in each analysis file
# --------------------------------------------------
experiment_id <- "Exp1"      # "Exp1" or "Exp2"
condition_id  <- "noInstr"   # "curvature" or "noInstr"

# Assumes cluster_coords_3d already exists and includes:
#   common: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, sm
#   Exp1: ang
#   Exp2: rng

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic checks
# --------------------------------------------------
required_common <- c("cluster", "D1", "D2", "D3", "nv", "sm")
missing_common <- setdiff(required_common, names(cluster_coords_3d))

if (length(missing_common) > 0) {
  stop(
    "cluster_coords_3d is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_common, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (experiment_id == "Exp1") {
  feature_var <- "ang"
} else if (experiment_id == "Exp2") {
  feature_var <- "rng"
} else {
  stop("experiment_id must be either 'Exp1' or 'Exp2'")
}

if (!(feature_var %in% names(cluster_coords_3d))) {
  stop(
    "For ", experiment_id, ", cluster_coords_3d must contain column: ", feature_var
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Envfit helper
# --------------------------------------------------
run_envfit_3d <- function(df, feature_var, permutations = 999) {
  coords <- df %>%
    select(D1, D2, D3)

  feats <- df %>%
    select(sm, nv, all_of(feature_var)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

  envfit(coords, feats, permutations = permutations, choices = 1:3)
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Extract envfit results into tidy table
# --------------------------------------------------
extract_envfit_vectors <- function(envfit_obj, cluster_id, experiment_id, condition_id) {

  arrows <- envfit_obj$vectors$arrows %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature")

  r2_vals <- envfit_obj$vectors$r
  p_vals  <- envfit_obj$vectors$pvals

  arrows %>%
    mutate(
      experiment = experiment_id,
      condition  = condition_id,
      cluster    = as.character(cluster_id),
      r2         = unname(r2_vals[feature]),
      pval       = unname(p_vals[feature])
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      feature,
      D1, D2, D3,
      r2,
      pval
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label = case_when(
        feature == "sm"  ~ "Smoothness",
        feature == "nv"  ~ "NV",
        feature == "rng" ~ "Range",
        feature == "ang" ~ "Angle",
        TRUE             ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      feature,
      feature_label,
      D1, D2, D3,
      r2,
      pval
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Run envfit per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------
clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(cluster_coords_3d$cluster)))

envfit_3d_by_cluster <- map(clusters, function(cl) {
  dfc <- cluster_coords_3d %>% filter(cluster == cl)
  run_envfit_3d(dfc, feature_var = feature_var, permutations = 999)
})
names(envfit_3d_by_cluster) <- clusters

# --------------------------------------------------
# Combine into one export table
# --------------------------------------------------
vectorfit_web_data <- imap_dfr(envfit_3d_by_cluster, function(env, cl) {
  extract_envfit_vectors(
    envfit_obj     = env,
    cluster_id     = cl,
    experiment_id  = experiment_id,
    condition_id   = condition_id
  )
})

# Optional: inspect
print(vectorfit_web_data)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Make output folder
# --------------------------------------------------
dir.create("mds_site", showWarnings = FALSE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write JSON
# --------------------------------------------------
write_json(
  vectorfit_web_data,
  path = file.path("mds_site", "vector_fits.json"),
  pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)

cat("Saved JSON to:", file.path("mds_site", "vector_fits.json"), "\n")
```
